items.title: Cech cohomology of an injective abelian sheaf is concentrated in degree zero

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Cech cohomology of an injective abelian sheaf with respect to an arbitrary covering of a site: it is I(U) in degree zero and vanishes in positive degrees (statement lines 1333-1349). The proof rewrites the groups by the description through representable sheaves (proof lines 1351-1355) and uses injactivity in the form of extendability of compatible families to kill the positive degrees (proof lines 1355-1358). The non-formal content is the extension argument. The claim is H2: one identification plus one extension argument.
